metadata.description: Print-grade document skills for Claude: investor teasers, annual reports and magazines as PDFs whose numbers you can audit.

plugins.name: print-studio
plugins.description: Three skills that turn Claude into a print designer who checks the maths: pdf-builder (HTML→PDF business documents), magazine-builder (Typst magazines, bookazines and annual reports) and finance-motion (financial results as a print PDF, an animated LinkedIn reel and an interactive web report, all from one validated data file). Every output is read back before it ships.
